Dead River Company

Posts no per-gallon price online. Four plans, sold in an enrollment season: its plans page says they have closed and reopen in the spring. Source, read 2026-11-19.

Pricing model

Equal Payment Plan: equal monthly payments without locking the price. Fixed Price Budget Plan: a locked price for the season, paid in equal monthly payments. Prepaid Fixed Plan: pay for all your fuel up front for what Dead River calls its lowest price per gallon. EasyCAP Plan: a capped price that falls if the market falls, paid in equal monthly payments.
